# Review submission status

| File | Status | Included in review metrics |
|---|---|---|
| `UNCONFIRMED_example_judgments_S001-S003.csv` | **UNCONFIRMED.** These choices were example answers generated by ChatGPT, not judgments from a confirmed reviewer. They are not reviewer evidence. | **No.** Excluded from every metric, precision, recall and agreement figure. |

The blank starter sheet (`../starter_review_sheet_v2.csv`) is unchanged and is the only starter. Confirmed judgments will be added as new,
separately named submissions with their reviewer identity and date. Earlier submissions are never overwritten.

The file was previously named `starter_v2_reviewer_submission_1_S001-S003.csv` (commit e308fd8). It was renamed, not rewritten, so its history is kept.
